entries.title: Numbers 31:1
segments: ¶Then the Lord said to Moses,

entries.title: Numbers 31:2
segments: Give the Midianites punishment for the wrong they did to the children of Israel: and after that you will go to rest with your people.

entries.title: Numbers 31:3
segments: So Moses said to the people, Let men from among you be armed for war to put into effect against Midian the Lord's punishment on them.

entries.title: Numbers 31:4
segments: From every tribe of Israel send a thousand to the war.

entries.title: Numbers 31:5
segments: So from the thousands of Israel a thousand were taken from every tribe, twelve thousand men armed for war.

entries.title: Numbers 31:6
segments: And Moses sent them out to war, a thousand from every tribe, and with them Phinehas, the son of Eleazar the priest, taking in his hands the vessels of the holy place and the horns for sounding the note of war.

entries.title: Numbers 31:7
segments: ¶And they made war on Midian, as the Lord gave orders to Moses; and they put to death every male.

entries.title: Numbers 31:8
segments: They put the kings of Midian to death with the rest, Evi and Reken and Zur and Hur and Reba, the five kings of Midian: and Balaam, the son of Beor, they put to death with the sword.

entries.title: Numbers 31:9
segments: The women of Midian with their little ones the children of Israel took prisoner; and all their cattle and flocks and all their goods they took for themselves;

entries.title: Numbers 31:10
segments: And after burning all their towns and all their tent-circles,

entries.title: Numbers 31:11
segments: They went away with the goods they had taken, man and beast.

entries.title: Numbers 31:12
segments: And the prisoners and the goods and everything they had taken, they took to Moses and Eleazar the priest and the people of Israel, to the tent-circle in the lowlands of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

entries.title: Numbers 31:13
segments: ¶Then Moses and Eleazar the priest and the chiefs of the people went out to them before they had come into the tent-circle.

entries.title: Numbers 31:14
segments: And Moses was angry with the chiefs of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds who had come back from the war.

entries.title: Numbers 31:15
segments: And Moses said to them, Why have you kept all the women safe?

entries.title: Numbers 31:16
segments: It was these who, moved by Balaam, were the cause of Israel's sin against the Lord in the question of Peor, because of which disease came on the people of the Lord.

entries.title: Numbers 31:17
segments: So now put every male child to death, and every woman who has had sex relations with a man.

entries.title: Numbers 31:18
segments: But all the female children who have had no sex relations with men, you may keep for yourselves.

entries.title: Numbers 31:19
segments: You yourselves will have to keep outside the tent-circle for seven days, anyone of you who has put any person to death or come near a dead body; and on the third day and on the seventh day make yourselves and your prisoners clean.

entries.title: Numbers 31:20
segments: And every bit of clothing, and anything made of leather or goats' hair or wood, you are to make clean.

entries.title: Numbers 31:21
segments: Then Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who had been to the fight, This is the rule of the law which the Lord has given to Moses:

entries.title: Numbers 31:22
segments: But gold and silver and brass and iron and tin and lead,

entries.title: Numbers 31:23
segments: And anything which may be heated, is to go through the fire and be made clean; but in addition it is to be put in the water of cleaning: and anything which may not go through the fire is to be put in the water.

entries.title: Numbers 31:24
segments: And on the seventh day, after washing your clothing, you will be clean, and then you may come into the tent-circle.

entries.title: Numbers 31:25
segments: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

entries.title: Numbers 31:26
segments: Get an account of everything which was taken in the war, of man and of beast, you and Eleazar the priest and the heads of families of the people:

entries.title: Numbers 31:27
segments: And let division be made of it into two parts, one for the men of war who went out to the fight, and one for all the people:

entries.title: Numbers 31:28
segments: And from the men of war who went out let there be offered to the Lord one out of every five hundred, from the persons, and from the oxen and asses and sheep:

entries.title: Numbers 31:29
segments: Take this from their part and give it to Eleazar the priest as an offering to be lifted up to the Lord.

entries.title: Numbers 31:30
segments: And from the part given to the children of Israel, take one out of every fifty, from the persons, and from the oxen and asses and sheep, and give it to the Levites who have the care of the House of the Lord.

entries.title: Numbers 31:31
segments: So Eleazar and Moses did as the Lord had given orders to Moses.

entries.title: Numbers 31:32
segments: Now the beasts taken, in addition to what the fighting-men took for themselves, were six hundred and seventy-five thousand sheep,

entries.title: Numbers 31:33
segments: And seventy-two thousand oxen,

entries.title: Numbers 31:34
segments: And sixty-one thousand asses;

entries.title: Numbers 31:35
segments: And thirty-two thousand persons, that is, women who had never had sex relations with a man.

entries.title: Numbers 31:36
segments: And the half given as their part to the men who went to the war, was three hundred and thirty-seven thousand, five hundred sheep,

entries.title: Numbers 31:37
segments: Of which the Lord's part was six hundred and seventy-five.

entries.title: Numbers 31:38
segments: The number of oxen was thirty-six thousand, of which the Lord's part was seventy-two;

entries.title: Numbers 31:39
segments: The number of asses was thirty thousand, five hundred, of which the Lord's part was sixty-one.

entries.title: Numbers 31:40
segments: And the number of persons was sixteen thousand, of which the Lord's part was thirty-two persons.

entries.title: Numbers 31:41
segments: And Moses gave the Lord's part, lifted up as an offering, to Eleazar the priest, as the Lord had given orders to Moses.

entries.title: Numbers 31:42
segments: And from the half given to the children of Israel, which Moses had kept separate from that given to the fighting-men,

entries.title: Numbers 31:43
segments: (Now the people's half was three hundred and thirty-seven thousand, five hundred sheep,

entries.title: Numbers 31:44
segments: And thirty-six thousand oxen,

entries.title: Numbers 31:45
segments: And thirty thousand, five hundred asses,

entries.title: Numbers 31:46
segments: And sixteen thousand persons;)

entries.title: Numbers 31:47
segments: Even from the children of Israel's half, Moses took one out of every fifty, men and beasts, and gave them to the Levites who had the care of the House of the Lord; as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

entries.title: Numbers 31:48
segments: ¶Then the men in authority over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, came to Moses,

entries.title: Numbers 31:49
segments: And said to him, Your servants have taken note of the number of all the fighting-men under our orders, and every one is present;

entries.title: Numbers 31:50
segments: And we have here an offering for the Lord from what every man took in the war, ornaments of gold, leg-chains and arm-rings, finger-rings, ear-rings, and neck-ornaments, to make our souls free from sin before the Lord.

entries.title: Numbers 31:51
segments: So Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from them, even all the worked ornaments.

entries.title: Numbers 31:52
segments: And the gold which the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds gave, as an offering to be lifted up before the Lord, came to sixteen thousand, seven hundred and fifty shekels.

entries.title: Numbers 31:53
segments: (For every man of the army had taken goods for himself in the war.)

entries.title: Numbers 31:54
segments: Then Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold given by the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, and took it into the Tent of meeting, to be a sign in memory of the children of Israel before the Lord.
